items.title: Carnell Tate: Finds end zone for first time in NFL
items.description:
Tate caught six of seven targets for 70 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 26-20 win over the Colts.

items.title: Tony Pollard: Leading rusher in first win of year
items.description:

items.title: Cam Ward: Quiet in Week 6 win
items.description:
Ward completed 11 of 22 passes for 102 yards and one touchdown with one interception in Sunday's 26-20 win over the Colts. He added seven yards on three carries.
